slides.heading: At the edge of the village
slides.body: A thin boy lives alone in a small, broken house. The roof leaks. The walls lean. Most nights he goes to sleep hungry.

slides.heading: No one left
slides.body: No family. No friends. Nothing worth stealing. The village has long stopped noticing him.

slides.heading: Torches in the dark
slides.body: Tonight, riders come down the hill carrying fire. Bandits. They want food, money, anything they can take.

slides.heading: Nothing to give
slides.body: They kick down his door and find nothing. Their leader laughs: "Then he is worth nothing. Burn it."

slides.heading: Fire
slides.body: Flames climb the walls. Smoke fills the room. The door is blocked, and the bandits are waiting outside.

call_to_action.heading: Fight to win. Win to become a street fighter.
call_to_action.body: Get out of the burning house alive.
